messages:
jordan_sales: Heads-up — Marigold Bank pilot. During streaming + function-calling tests the SDK websocket handshake is intermittently failing. Need quick triage and answers for pricing + security. Anyone oncall?

maria_se: on it. saw 2 patterns: websocket close immediately with `403` and occasional `502` from websocket-proxy. customer testing with our JS streaming SDK (v0.9.3).

lee_eng: can you paste the raw error and client config? e.g., headers, auth type, whether they're using a proxy. small config mismatch often causes early close.

jordan_sales: pasted logs from their engineer below. note: they're behind a corporate proxy and use SAML-backed SSO to our reserved instance.

maria_se: ```
ERR: websocket close before handshake: code=1006, detail="tls: handshake failure"
PROXY: 502 gateway error from ws-proxy (upstream read timeout)
SDK: streaming.connect({ model: 'redwood-1-stream', token: 'redacted', pingInterval: 30000 })
```

lee_eng: looks like TLS handshake + proxy idle timeouts. two quick asks: 1) what SDK version exactly? 2) what proxy (squid/akamai/CAPS)?

jordan_sales: they confirmed JS SDK 0.9.3, corporate proxy (BlueOcean gateway). also asked about a fallback path if streaming is flaky — they'd like HTTP chunked streaming or function-calls over normal REST.

alex_platform: fallback is supported: you can hit the standard completions endpoint with `stream=true` (chunked) — slightly higher latency but more robust through corporate proxies. For function calls we also support non-streamed sync replies.

lee_eng: temporary mitigation: increase `pingInterval` to 15s on client, set websocket `max_frame_size` to 16MB, and enable `X-Forwarded-For` passthrough on their proxy. That addresses most proxy-related drops.

maria_se: QA note: we also saw one case where reserved instance NAT mapping caused intermittent 403s. If they're using a Dedicated node behind their SAML integration, we should verify the Identity Provider (IdP) assertion TTL.

jordan_sales: security side: Marigold asked for SOC2, BYOK, and whether Private (on-prem) deploy is possible. Need short answers I can put in the security questionnaire today.

secbot: SOC2 Type II report: available (we can share under NDA). BYOK: supported for Private and Dedicated (via KMS/HSM integration) — for Hosted we offer customer-managed keys in select regions, timeline depends on contract. Private on-prem: we have an onprem bundle and a template SOW.

maria_se: rough delivery timelines: SOC2 artifacts — immediate once NDA signed; BYOK setup for Dedicated — 2–4 weeks; Private on-prem pilot — 4–6 weeks from agreement (depends on infra readiness).

jordan_sales: pricing question: they want cost for sustained 200k tokens/day streaming + 100k embeddings/month during pilot. Any quick estimate to include in the POC deck?

alex_platform: quick ballpark: hosted streaming at that volume ~ $X/day (token pricing + streaming surcharge). If they want guaranteed throughput use Dedicated — monthly reserved capacity. For preliminary numbers: Hosted estimate ~ $2k–4k/month, Dedicated starting commit for that throughput ~ $8k/month (incl. baseline GPUs) — final quote from finance.

maria_se: I'll assemble a cleaner breakout: tokens, embedding units, reserved commit, optional BYOK setup fee, and estimated data egress.

lee_eng: technical ask: can we repro locally with their proxy settings? If they can provide an IP allowlist, I'll spin up a replicated proxy and run the JS SDK against our staging reserved node.

jordan_sales: they're willing to give a short-lived test account and proxy creds for repro. I'll DM the creds to @lee_eng.

maria_se: POC handoff checklist (short):
- capture exact SDK version + config (done)
- repro with corporate proxy (lee)
- provide fallback instructions (alex)
- deliver SOC2 + BYOK notes (secbot/maria)
- pricing ballpark + finance intro (maria/alex)
- schedule 1hr troubleshooting call with customer + platform engs (jordan)

alex_platform: also recommend enabling `strict_caching: false` during the pilot to avoid prefix cache misses while they iterate on prompts.

deploy-bot: scheduled: #pilot-troubleshoot-call with Marigold — Thu 10:00am UTC. invite sent.

jordan_sales: awesome. Next steps: maria — send the security one-pager + NDA link; lee — follow up once you have repro; alex — I'll need the fallback snippet to include in the deck. Will update customer after call. :thumbsup:

maria_se: on it. NDA link + SOC2 upload by EOD.

lee_eng: starting repro now. I'll post logs in this thread.

alex_platform: fallback snippet (JS):
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions?stream=true', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1-stream', input: '...' })
})
.then(r => r.body.getReader().read())
```

jordan_sales: thanks team — closing loop after call.

maria_se: :rocket:
